description.value: Nk'Mip Cellars is the first Indigenous-owned winery in North America, operated by the Osoyoos Indian Band on their 32,000-acre Sonoran Desert reserve at the southern end of the Okanagan Valley. The winery produces international award-winning wines across multiple tiers and is home to the Sweetgrass @Nk'Mip Cellars restaurant, offering lunch in a setting rich with Syilx cultural history. For touring cyclists on the Okanagan wine route, it is a distinctive cultural and culinary destination unlike any other stop in the region.
